what_it_does: Pirate reduces virtual reality video streaming bandwidth to extremely low levels (down to 0.1 bits per pixel) while maintaining 90 frames-per-second rendering on edge devices. It exploits stereo redundancy—the left and right eye views in VR are very similar. Pirate transmits only one eye's full view at a time, alternates between left and right, and reconstructs the unsent view on-device using precomputed geometric information (disparity maps and optical flow) without needing a large machine learning model.
